review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: The Velt page-mode composer is rendered as a VeltCommentDialog instance, so a generic .vc-card selector also matches the composer dialog; scope thread-card selectors with :has(.vc-message) to target real comment cards.
learnings.evidence: harvey Loop1: .vc-card first-match was the page-mode composer (42px) not a comment card; :has(.vc-message) fixed measurement

learnings.statement: After opening a Velt sidebar wireframe, the visible styled clone renders ~5-6s later (not immediately); measurement drive waits must be >=15s and the capture surface must be the visible clone class (.vc-panel/.vc-card), never the 0-size <velt-*-wireframe> template tag.
learnings.evidence: harvey Loop1: waitFor 8s timed out; visible clone appeared at t~6s; wireframe template tag measured 0px ('empty shell')

learnings.statement: A Figma text node's auto-layout container props (display:flex, justify/align:center, gap, padding) are often container METADATA, not real visual properties of the rendered text; verify against the frame PNG (message renders left-aligned) before asserting them, or delta-compare flags false diffs.
learnings.evidence: harvey Loop1: 'justification' node asserted flex/center/gap/28px-indent but the frame shows the message left-aligned matching the render

learnings.statement: A text element's box.x/box.w are content-driven (real user name vs design mock name); assert only STYLE (color/font) on name/timestamp text nodes and use a content-independent position gap (avatar->name x) to satisfy the repeating-surface gap requirement.
learnings.evidence: harvey Loop1: name box.w 93(design) vs 21(rendered 'Me'); dropping text box + avatar->name x gap made 6 thread blocks delta-clean
